color.note: Dark is the primary theme. Light is an added theme on Eepy's own shell white (#f8f7f5): same roles, ink and primary inverted. The four spotlight grounds are identical in both themes.

tokens.name: canvas
tokens.usage: Page background. Dark: near-black with a faint warmth. Light: Eepy's shell white.

tokens.name: surface-1
tokens.usage: One lift above canvas: cards, secondary pills, inputs, mockup tiles, icon buttons. Light: pure white.

tokens.name: surface-2
tokens.usage: Two lifts: featured card, selected tab, menu hover. Marks 'active' by depth, not colour.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: 1px borders on input groups and comparison-table dividers.

tokens.name: hairline-soft
tokens.usage: Subtler 1px dividers: between FAQ rows, footer column rules, comparison-row underlines.

tokens.name: hairline-strong
tokens.usage: Added for interaction: border of a text input on hover (one step brighter than hairline).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headlines and body text on canvas, surface-1, surface-2 (≥16:1 both themes). Not for spotlight cards — use on-spotlight.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: meta, footer links, table labels, deselected tabs, placeholders. Dark ≥6:1, light ≥4.9:1 on all three surfaces.

tokens.name: ink-disabled
tokens.usage: Added for interaction: label of disabled buttons, tabs and inputs on surface-1 or canvas (2.8:1 — disabled controls are exempt from contrast minimums; never use for live text).

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Fill of the primary CTA pill: white on dark, black on light.

tokens.name: primary-hover
tokens.usage: Added for interaction: primary pill on hover. on-primary on it 16.8:1.

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Text on primary and inverse-canvas fills (21:1).

tokens.name: inverse-canvas
tokens.usage: White surface for light-on-dark CTA pills and the occasional light thumbnail inside a dark grid. Never a section ground.

tokens.name: inverse-ink
tokens.usage: Text on inverse-canvas.

tokens.name: accent-blue
tokens.usage: The single chromatic signal: links, the 2px focus ring, checked controls, selection. Dark #0099ff (≥6.1:1), light #0068c9 (≥4.7:1). Never a background or button fill.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Added: tick, dot and thumb on accent-blue fills (checked checkbox, radio, switch) and text on error fills. Dark: black on #0099ff 7.0:1; light: white on #0068c9 5.5:1.

tokens.name: on-spotlight
tokens.usage: Text on spotlight-violet, -magenta and -coral cards in both themes (always white, never ink). 5.3:1 on violet; 3.4:1 magenta and 3.1:1 coral — 24px+ text only on those two.

tokens.name: spotlight-violet
tokens.usage: Ground of the default spotlight card (same in both themes). Text in on-spotlight (5.3:1).

tokens.name: spotlight-magenta
tokens.usage: Ground of the magenta spotlight card. on-spotlight is 3.4:1: 24px+ text only.

tokens.name: spotlight-orange
tokens.usage: Ground of the sunset spotlight card. ink fails on it (2.6:1): set its text in on-spotlight-orange (8.1:1).

tokens.name: on-spotlight-orange
tokens.usage: Text on spotlight-orange cards in both themes: black, 8.1:1. Never white or ink on orange.

tokens.name: spotlight-coral
tokens.usage: Ground of the coral spotlight card. on-spotlight is 3.1:1: 24px+ text only.

tokens.name: error
tokens.usage: Error state: 2px input ring, error message + icon, destructive confirmations. Text ≥4.9:1 in both themes. Never colour alone.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Comparison checkmarks and success toasts, glyph or text only (≥5:1 both themes); always with a label.

tokens.name: time-track
tokens.usage: Added (time visualisation): the pill track behind a day timeline.

tokens.name: time-busy
tokens.usage: Commitments on a timeline — classes, commute, meals. Neutral on purpose: only focus and breaks are coloured.

tokens.name: time-done
tokens.usage: Busy segments already past, one step brighter than time-busy so the day reads as progress.

tokens.name: time-icon
tokens.usage: Icons inside busy and done segments (≥ 3:1 on both).

tokens.name: time-focus-start
tokens.usage: Start stop of the focus gradient (cyan); also the colour of highlighted times and the glowing headline word.

tokens.name: time-focus
tokens.usage: End stop and identity colour of focus sessions with Eepy. Validated against time-break for colour-blind separation (ΔE ≥ 29).

tokens.name: time-break
tokens.usage: Break segments inside the day (validated against time-focus; inside the dark lightness band).

tokens.name: time-pin
tokens.usage: Activity pins above the track (markers, always with an icon and a label).

tokens.name: on-time-pin
tokens.usage: Icon on a time-pin marker (10:1).

tokens.name: time-wake
tokens.usage: Wake-up end of the day: alarm icon, end mark and first time label (≥ 5:1 as text in both themes).

tokens.name: time-sleep
tokens.usage: Bedtime end of the day: bed icon, end mark and last time label. Close to time-focus in hue, so it is never a fill — only a labelled end marker.

tokens.name: time-tick
tokens.usage: Hourly ticks under the track.

tokens.name: time-tick-major
tokens.usage: Labelled ticks (e.g. 12:00, 18:00).

tokens.name: energy-low
tokens.usage: Bottom of the focus-curve gradient (low focus).

tokens.name: energy-mid
tokens.usage: Middle of the focus-curve gradient.

tokens.name: energy-high
tokens.usage: Top of the focus-curve gradient and the peak badge. Colour repeats what height already shows; never the only signal.

tokens.name: on-energy-high
tokens.usage: Icon on the peak badge.

tokens.name: atmosphere-deep
tokens.usage: Base of a VizPanel: the deep night tone behind data.

tokens.name: atmosphere-mid
tokens.usage: Upper-left haze of a VizPanel.

tokens.name: atmosphere-glow
tokens.usage: Lower-right blue glow of a VizPanel. Atmosphere colours live only inside VizPanel cards, never as page backgrounds.

styles.name: display-xxl
styles.usage: Largest hero headline, one per page. Tracking is -5% of size: keep the ratio when scaling down.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Section opener headlines. OpenType ss02 on.

styles.name: display-lg
styles.usage: Sub-section openers; hero size on tablet. OpenType ss02 on.

styles.name: display-md
styles.usage: Card titles and small display; hero size on mobile.

styles.name: headline
styles.usage: Pricing tier names, FAQ category titles. The only 700 in the system. OpenType cv05.

styles.name: subhead
styles.sample: A lead line beside a display headline.
styles.usage: Lead copy next to display headlines and the text inside spotlight cards. OpenType cv11.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.usage: Hero subhead, lead paragraphs. OpenType cv11.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Default body copy and card descriptions.
styles.usage: Default body, card descriptions, inputs, FAQ rows. OpenType cv11.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.usage: Comparison rows, nav links, template and mockup tiles. OpenType cv11.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Eyebrows, footer columns, meta. OpenType cv11.

styles.name: button
styles.usage: Every pill button label. OpenType cv11.

type.note: Mona Sans and Inter are served by Google Fonts; components/bundle.css loads them. Inter: enable cv01 cv05 cv09 cv11 ss03 ss07 on body text.

spacing.note: Built on 5px steps (5/10/15/20/30) with a few 4/8/12 utility values.

tokens.name: space-hair
tokens.usage: Hairline offsets and borders.

tokens.name: space-xxs
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gaps, chip padding.

tokens.name: space-xs
tokens.usage: Vertical padding of tabs and translucent buttons; tight stacks.

tokens.name: space-sm
tokens.usage: Template-card padding; gaps in dense rows.

tokens.name: space-md
tokens.usage: Horizontal pill-button padding; mockup interior padding.

tokens.name: space-lg
tokens.usage: Card padding and grid gaps.

tokens.name: space-xl
tokens.usage: Spotlight-card padding; desktop side gutters.

tokens.name: space-xxl
tokens.usage: Gaps between blocks inside a section.

tokens.name: space-section
tokens.usage: Vertical padding of a page section (about 64px on dense pricing tables).

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Utility chips, table rows, nav bar.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inline tags, badges.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Text inputs, list items, FAQ rows.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Template-card thumbnails.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Content cards, pricing cards, mockup tiles.

tokens.name: radius-xxl
tokens.usage: Spotlight cards and oversized panels; translucent buttons.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Every text CTA and tab: the brand's only button shape.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Circular icon buttons, avatars.

shadow.note: Depth comes mostly from surface lift (canvas → surface-1 → surface-2) and spotlight colour, not shadows.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: Level 2: floating product cards and modals — a faint light top edge plus a soft drop.

tokens.name: shadow-focus
tokens.usage: Level 3 halo for focus and selection, from the source. Always drawn together with the solid 2px accent-blue focus outline (offset 2px) — the halo alone is under 3:1.

tokens.name: shadow-error
tokens.usage: Halo of an input in error, mirroring shadow-focus; drawn with the solid 2px error ring.

tokens.name: shadow-overlay
tokens.usage: Added: modals, menus, toasts and tooltips floating above the page.

tokens.name: glow-focus
tokens.usage: Added: the soft glow around focus segments and the highlighted headline word.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Added: opacity of the canvas-coloured scrim behind a modal.
